parameters.name: order
parameters.value: system message, user sequence embeddings, assistant <CELL DESCRIPTION>

evidence.quote: we adopted a specific instruction-following prompt structure that integrates a system message and the contextualized gene embeddings

System : You are a scientific assistant specialized in cell description predictions. Given the cell sentence embeddings, describe it clearly and concisely in professional language. User : Sequence embeddings: H g, 1 | H g, 2 | ... | H g,N Assistant : < CELL DESCRIPTION >

decisions.rationale: R6: an instruction-following prompt structure is text serialization.

evidence.quote: The model takes single-cell RNA-seq profiles as input

decisions.rationale: R0: the element names the input data object without applying a transformation.

evidence.quote: We chose Geneformer (Theodoris et al., 2023b; Chen et al., 2024), a transformer-based model pre-trained specifically on single-cell genomics data on masked gene prediction task, as our cell encoder
Geneformer produces a sequence of N gene embeddings

decisions.rationale: R3: the receiving learned encoder is a named learned module and its internal computation is retained as a module boundary.

evidence.quote: We introduce a lightweight adapter module to bridge the dimensional and semantic gaps between the Geneformer's output and the LLM's input embedding space.
This module consists of a two-layer feedforward network with non-linear activation that projects each gene embedding to the natural language semantic space.
The adapter module remains trainable in both training strategies

decisions.rationale: R3: an adapter module is represented as a learned project operation with the stated feedforward architecture and trainability.
decisions.uncertainty: The specific non-linear activation function is not named.

This module consists of a two-layer feedforward network with non-linear activation that projects each gene embedding to the natural language semantic space.

decisions.rationale: R3: mapping features into the language-model embedding space is a project operation.
